instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, trim, and small dice strawberries. Set aside.
Place sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl, then stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup granulated sugar
1 tsp cinnamon, ground

instructions.primary_message: Arrange lavash (about 8 x 10-inches in size) on a flat surface. Spread 1/4-cup cream cheese over each piece of lavash in an even layer, making sure to spread it to the edges.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 (8 x 10-inch) piece lavash bread
1 cup whipped cream cheese spread

instructions.primary_message: Sprinkle cinnamon-sugar and strawberries evenly over the cream cheese. With the short edge of the lavash facing towards you, tightly roll to close. Cut each lavash roll-up crosswise into 8 "pinwheels." (Secure with toothpicks if necessary.)
To serve, divide pinwheels between plates and enjoy!
